reviews.review: It is a fun game with fast fire fights with many different playstyles. I originally played this on consoles because my PC wasn't strong enough so you do need a decent PC for this. This is full of a collection of weapons and warframes or characters that change your playstyle completely you can go invisible or be invulnerable it is up to you. What also is nice is it has lore inside of it so you get a story while you slice down waves of enemies with your modded guns.
Love this game loads, its a semi complex game, friendly players and very beautiful enviroments etc  10/10

warframe is simalar to destiny in a lot of ways, but completely different as well. Yes that doesn't make sense, but here is the lowdown. 

1) Free to play (can use real money to unlock some stuff, but recognize and dont bit#h developers put work into this game it didnt rise from a abyss of gaming happy places) also the money you invest is what will give future updates, more in game toys, and really keep the game alive. So you dont have to pay, but dont complain about anyone or anything that does cost. I dont pay because my ass is broke, but I would. Cause its a blast.
2) its got FPS aspects mix with a mmo feel. You can team up and do some random adventures, you can solo play, basically its what you make of it. Some things are difficult you need the team. Plus they make it fun if you find a good group.
3) Crysis combat suit except variety of suits/abilities and your a fricken nano-tech ninja common you can not beat that.
